title: Absent update function
defect: Frozen inventory has no update function. SAP update-task scheduler not available.
sapRequirement: Target release/compiler, real dependencies, activation and relevant SAP runtime tests.

rootCause.explanation: Classic v758 case supplies no update function or SAP scheduler. Invocation fails before update semantics. No supported classic missing-function promise was established.
rootCause.scope: The enabled check_syntax function-resolution behavior differs by language profile; it cannot establish a SAP update environment.

note: Track-related closure capabilities are broader than this individual case; no claim of a new case-specific closure verdict.
